purpose: Make semantic schema migration a real part of the authenticated application-update journey: bind the target release to an exact schema version and full migration-program fingerprint, derive the exact profile-specific contiguous chain, stage every selected version edge off the live canonical database, preserve Artist/Song/version/asset identity, install only a fully validated candidate under the update maintenance hold, and preserve the updater's exact pre-package rollback snapshot for whole-transaction compensation.

lineage.outcome: An authenticated N0TE release can update a real Artist profile across an explicit semantic-schema boundary without silently losing durable creative identity or splitting package rollback from creative-state rollback.
lineage.capability: Authenticated release-bound semantic-schema migration inside the safe update transaction

n0te2_dependencies: APP-01C durable ApplicationUpdateCoordinator and compensation journal
CORE-01 canonical LineageStore metadata/identity and crash-consistent persistence
APP-01D uninstall retention and held-service boundary
legacy_rejections: orphan migration utility not used by the real updater
release package not cryptographically bound to its semantic schema/program
authenticate only one profile-specific migration subset instead of the full release program
in-place live migration before candidate validation
overwrite the update rollback snapshot during schema migration
blind package rollback after ambiguous schema/ownership state
strand the update coordination lease during guarded recovery
claim success without normal target Headquarters reopen

completion_proof: the authenticated ReleaseManifest includes application_schema_version and the canonical SHA-256 of the full exact migration-step program; mismatched target/program is rejected before update snapshot/quit/package mutation

the full authenticated program is ordered/contiguous and may serve multiple source-profile versions; planning selects only the exact suffix from the profile's current schema to the release target, or an explicit empty subset when already current

safe update preparation begins from the owned RUNNING profile, creates the existing APP-01C pre-package RecoveryManager snapshot, stops the runtime, proves the stopped live database is logically identical to that snapshot, then durably binds the exact migration plan and full program to the update-plan and manifest fingerprints
read-only update schema planning does not treat a persisted lease as proof of liveness; authoritative maintenance ownership is resolved at execution with the shared probe/lease machinery
package execution acquires the existing update profile maintenance hold; schema migration reuses and verifies that exact hold rather than acquiring a second competing owner
the updater's original pre-package rollback snapshot is preserved and revalidated throughout schema work, including the current-schema no-op path; update-bound migration never overwrites it
source-to-target selected steps form one exact contiguous chain; missing, duplicate, out-of-order and downgrade plans fail closed
migration SQL executes transactionally only against an off-live staged SQLite candidate; failed staged SQL or candidate validation leaves the live database unchanged

candidate quick_check, foreign_key_check, embedded profile identity, primary/active identity and canonical Artist/Song/version/asset/version-asset fingerprint must match the prepared source before installation
prior migration history is immutable; successful version edges append exact inspectable migration ID/version/step-fingerprint/description records and installed history must equal staged history
only a fully validated candidate is atomically installed under the update hold; target Headquarters reopen/integrity/close remains required before the update can succeed
package-success plus schema failure and schema-success plus target-Headquarters failure flow through the existing package rollback plus exact original snapshot restore compensation transaction

ambiguous schema result, unreadable/lost maintenance ownership, snapshot restore failure, package rollback ambiguity or validation database-release uncertainty remains explicit RECOVERY_REQUIRED and never authorizes blind retry/rollback; guarded recovery releases update coordination while retaining the profile hold when recovery ownership must remain explicit

the normal consumer smoke is the real update journey: running Artist profile -> authenticated package/schema program -> stopped profile -> package install -> semantic migration -> target Headquarters validation -> exact Artist/Song/version/asset reopen

APP-01 parent audit finds no remaining concrete shared APP primitive after A-E: platform package/signing/customer acceptance, diagnostics presentation, UX reachability and final release proof retain their downstream owners rather than creating an adjacency-driven APP-01F
non_scope: schema changes outside an authenticated bounded release program
next_selection_rule: If APP-01E lands without a newly observed same-class defect, close APP-01 as a construction dependency only, reconcile canonical Drive/repository state, and globally reselect from all newly eligible product nodes. Do not create APP-01F for downstream platform, UX, diagnostics-presentation or release-acceptance work.
